name: Kogda Plachut Gljuki
source:
After Umineko EP4, Beatrice needs another golden land. But she needs a person to create a golden land in the village of Hinamizawa.

[Edited from [url=https://www.deviantart.com/ivansorokin50/art/When-Glitch-Cry-VER-1-0-748610965]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
《海猫鸣泣之时》第4章之后，贝阿朵莉切需要另一片黄金乡。但她需要一个人，在雏见泽村创造黄金乡。

（改编自[url=https://www.deviantart.com/ivansorokin50/art/When-Glitch-Cry-VER-1-0-748610965]DeviantArt[/url]）
